CURRENT SCENE:
古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边。可是孟母注意，住在墓地的旁边影响孟子。他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩，所以孟母决定他们会搬家。这次，他们住在城市里的商店的旁边，从早到晚很吵。

ITEMS:

[I14] 【孟子】跟孟母住在墓地的旁边   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: first appearance of 孟子: briefly introduce who this is
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧和他的妈妈原来住在墓地的旁边 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧和他的妈妈住在离墓地很近 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: 孟子和[-孟子的]妈妈一直住在墓地的旁边

[I15] 孟子跟【孟母】住在墓地的旁边   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: first appearance of 孟母: briefly introduce who this is
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: 孟子和[-孟子的]妈妈一直住在墓地的旁边
  her past correction: [-孟子]和孟子的妈妈一直住在墓地的旁边
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧和他的妈妈原来住在墓地的旁边 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears

[I16] 可是孟母注意【^】   correction: ∅ → 到   strength: error
  checker's note: 注意到 means “notice/realize” a fact
  rule card (conditional_jiu, Coherence: connectors): Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <meaning/condition> leads naturally to <result>, so use 只要……就 or put the subject before 就 (Subj. + 就 + V.).  Her terms: 只要……就, Subj. + 就, Subj.+就, 才 Num.就V., 才Num.就V.
  her past correction: 可是孟子的妈妈[+就]有别的看法 — her note: or 他有的时候跟朋友玩儿
  her past correction: 可是孟子的妈妈[有别的看法→就抱怨] — her note: wrong conjunctions, 他只要跟朋友玩儿 ; 只要……就as long as
  her past correction: [-可是]孟子的妈妈一直很控制他

[I17] 住在墓地的旁边【^】影响孟子   correction: ∅ → 会   strength: suggestion
  rule card (formal_register, Vocabulary): Choose words that fit the sentence’s register and meaning: 真 is usually conversational, while 使 fits formal words such as 失业; 本+N. is usually formal advertisement/news language and can imply ownership, and 却 indicates an unexpected semantic turn.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <wrong> is <conversational/formal/ownership-implying> here, while <correct> fits the <formal register/meaning/context>; use 却 only for an unexpected semantic turn.  Her terms: 本+N.
  her past correction: 墓地的人[真→很]影响孟子 — her note: “真” is usually used in conversation
  her past correction: 孟母[恐怕→怕]孟子住在墓地的旁边对孟子有影响 — her note: 恐怕usually does not take Subj. except 我
  her past correction: 孟子和[-孟子的]妈妈一直住在墓地的旁边

[I18] 他常常跟朋友们【祭拜玩】   correction: 祭拜玩 → 玩祭拜的游戏   strength: error
  checker's note: 玩 must come before the activity being played
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: 他们[一起常常→常常一起]去祭拜
  her past correction: 他们一起常常[去祭拜，会去墓地→去墓地祭拜]
  her past correction: 他[-有的时候]只要跟朋友玩儿 — her note: wrong conjunctions, 他只要跟朋友玩儿 ; 只要……就as long as

[I19] 所以孟母决定【他们会】搬家   correction: 他们会 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 决定搬家 does not take 他们会 here
  rule card (haide_harmful_result, Vocabulary): Use 害得 + N/sb. + harmful result (or a harmful clause). The result must be genuinely harmful: neutral events such as 搬家 or 玩儿, and mild feelings such as 不高兴, do not fit after 害得.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: after 害得 + <person/noun>, use a genuinely harmful result; <neutral or mild result> is not harmful enough.  Her terms: 害得 + N/sb. + Harmful result, 害得+Sb.+V., 害得 + clause (harmful result)
  her past correction: ⟦这害得孟母决定搬家⟧ — her note: “害得“ is followed by something harmful, 搬家is not harmful
  her past correction: 所以妈妈跟孟子一起搬家[+了] — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [-所以]妈妈跟孟子一起搬家

items.explanation: This character appears for the first time, so please introduce 孟子 briefly with an identifying noun phrase, not only his name.
This character appears for the first time, so please introduce 孟母 briefly, for example as 孟子的妈妈.
Use 注意到 when you mean “notice” or “realize” a fact.
It would be more natural to say 会影响孟子 to show that living beside a cemetery may have this result.
Put 玩 before the activity being played. Say 玩祭拜的游戏.
After 决定, use the action directly: 决定搬家. Do not add 他们会 here.
